What's really inside an atom, and why is the periodic table in this order? Four discoveries, one century — from a knife and a gold coin to the number that fixed the table. Cut gold in half, then again. How small can you go before it stops being gold? Dalton weighed atoms. Thomson found a piece inside them. Rutherford found their tiny centre.
